summary: Intermittent SSE half-open handoff: heartbeats dropped and stream finalization missing
description: Issue summary: Customer (CartoMaps) reports intermittent SSE streaming sessions where the browser receives partial content and never gets the final 'end' event. Impact: user-facing generation UI shows truncated paragraphs and never shows completion for ~6% of streaming sessions during a 3-hour window. Environment: prod (us-east), dedicated capacity pool for CartoMaps, traffic through our edge ALB + nginx sidecar + edge-proxy chain. Repro rate: ~6% of sessions for this customer over 2026-03-10 09:00–12:00 UTC. Observed: heartbeat events stop being delivered to the client during an edge connection handoff; subsequently the session is left 'half-open' on the server side and the finalization marker is not emitted. Expected: on a connection handoff or short disconnect, server should emit an explicit terminal event or resume stream reliably and ensure final JSON object is delivered.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use CartoMaps prod config (dedicated) with long-running SSE generation (20–60s).
2) Simulate edge connection handoff (ALB connection drain + client rebind) or force nginx upstream worker restart during an active stream.
3) Observe that client receives heartbeats then a gap, then reconnection; final 'end' event not received and UI stays in 'streaming' state.
4) Repro is intermittent; easier to surface when handoffs occur during high-traffic bursts or when keepalive timers align with upstream drain window.
logs_and_artifacts: 2026-03-10T09:12:14Z edge-proxy WARN connection handoff id=abc123 (ALB drain)
streaming-service INFO session=carto-55ab dropped-heartbeat after 11s gap (kept-open)
client SDK debug: SSE heartbeat last_received=2026-03-10T09:12:14.504Z, reconnection attempt 1 at +120ms; no 'end' event in subsequent resume frames
partial payload samples: "...map tiles generated for region X." (no closing JSON)
initial_investigation_notes: Triage (Priya): probable involvement of edge-proxy handling of half-open TCP when ALB drains connections. Early logs show ALB RST/FIN close during worker handoff; nginx sidecar sometimes coalesces keepalives and forwards an abbreviated stream to edge-proxy. Edge-proxy then rebinds to a different upstream; stream state machine observed to not emit terminal marker if heartbeat gap > keepalive threshold. Repro locally by inducing same ALB drain sequence; confirmed similar session left without finalization in 3/20 tries. Hypothesis: connection-handoff race between keepalive timer and streaming-service resume path leads to lost terminal emission and stale session mapping in kv-cache layer.
investigation_actions: Captured tcpdump at edge-proxy for one repro: saw FIN from ALB to old upstream, new upstream accepted connection, session_id mapping not rehydrated before resume attempt.
Instrumented streaming-service to log resume path decisions (w/ trace-id). Added temporary logging at streaming-service:resume() and session-state.finalize().
Deployed a canary patch to edge-proxy to set SO_KEEPALIVE more aggressively and avoid coalescing heartbeat frames (gh pr linked).
comments: 2026-03-10 10:05 - Priya Singh (Support): Notified customer of ongoing investigation and recommended short-term workaround: refresh page if stream remains 'in progress' >30s; provided steps for exporting partial transcript.

2026-03-10 12:40 - Marco Ortega (SRE): Captured packet traces and confirmed half-open window where nginx sidecar forwards partial frames as a single burst. Suspect nginx keepalive timeout interaction with ALB drain policy.

2026-03-11 09:30 - Liam O'Connor (Eng): Rolled out edge-proxy canary with keepalive tweak to 3s and added explicit session end fallback on resume path; monitoring now shows drop to <0.5% for CartoMaps in canary region.

2026-03-12 02:10 - Priya Singh (Support): Customer confirmed significant reduction in truncated sessions after applying workaround and seeing canary behavior; asked for schedule for full rollout and postmortem.
mitigation_and_workaround: Short term: advise client to perform a page refresh or re-open stream if heartbeat gap > 20s; server-side: temporary canary toggled to force terminal 'end' emission if resume fails within 2s of reconnect. Instrumentation added to alert on streams with missing finalizer after 10s.
resolution: Hotfix merged to streaming-service to add a deterministic finalize-on-handoff path (PR gh.com/redwood-inference/streaming-service@pr/1204). Edge-proxy keepalive/coalescing fix merged and rolled to all edge clusters 2026-03-12 03:45 UTC. Post-rollout monitoring shows truncated sessions for CartoMaps reduced from ~6% to 0.3% during the same traffic window. Follow-up: publish runbook and add automated integration test that induces ALB drain during active SSE and asserts terminal event is delivered.
postmortem_actions: 1) Update edge-proxy runbook for ALB drain handoffs and set recommended ALB drain timeout to 30s for dedicated pools.
2) Add integration test to CI that simulates ALB drain + nginx restart while SSE active.
3) Add alert: streaming-service session finalizer failure rate > 0.5% for any customer -> P1 page.
4) Reach out to CartoMaps CSM and schedule a 1:1 review; share fix and runbook.
status_notes: Canary shows fix effective. Preparing scheduling for full cluster rollout and customer postmortem. Assigned follow-up tasks to Engineering and SRE.
